value to be payable after warranty period. The bidder must be a manufacturer or their authorized agents having a place of business in any state of India are eligible to partici pate in this bid. The bidders should submit “Manufacturer’s Authoriz ation Form” for each items quoted and shall be submitted along wit h technical bid, as per the format enclosed in the bid document (For mat “F”). M.
